messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] estimated effects of qtl
parts:
> at each qtl there is additive and dominant effect and at each
> interaction also.
> Is this output true?
> why there is no total estimated effect for each qtl?
> how can I report this result?.

In an intercross, each QTL will have two effects, and interactions will
have four.
If you want just the estimated percent variance explained by the QTL,
that is shown in the "drop one QTL" table.

karl
